notes.title: Jan 18 Update Notes: Optimizations, Controls, and Spiders (Oh My!)
notes.content:
We understand spiders might be a challenge for some players, and if that’s kept you from diving into Happy Hotel, we’ve got you covered!

1. Arachnophobia Mode:
A new Arachnophobia Mode has been added to the Options menu.
When enabled, spiders will be replaced with... well, NOT spiders! Now you can enjoy the game without the creepy crawlies.

2. Major Optimizations:
Improved performance to ensure the game runs more smoothly, even on lower-spec systems.

3. Control Updates:
Adjusted gamepad controls for a more intuitive experience:
- Sprint is now on the left trigger.
- Interact is now on the top face button.

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 15
notes.content:
After watching several streams and gathering player feedback, I've made some usability adjustments to improve the clarity and enjoyment of specific levels:

- Adjusted the trigger timing on the "Chairs" floor to provide a little more breathing room.
- Enhanced lighting on the multi-door floor to improve navigation and understanding.
- Added audio cues to the Marco Polo floor for better player feedback.
- Tweaked the "Ball" on the ball floor to feel less threatening.
- Improved lighting on the water level to subtly guide forward progression.
